picks.game: Golden State Valkyries at Las Vegas Aces · Las Vegas · 3:00 PM ET

Stats (WNBA Stats, Jun 6): Kelsey Plum 26.8 PPG season avg (league leader), 72.9% true shooting (elite efficiency). 9-of-12 games scoring 23+ PPG. Home games avg 28.2 PPG (vs 25.4 away). 5.2 assists per game (primary playmaker).

T2 (Matchup): Golden State defensive rating vs guards: 101.2 (below league avg of 100.5, worse than Vegas's 98.1). Perimeter defense weakness (switching heavy, allows threes). Plum exploits perimeter + mid-range scoring (14 PPG from 3-ball, 8 PPG mid-range). Vegas pace favorable (100+ poss/48 min).
T3 (Situational): Home game advantage (+2.8 PPG for Plum historically). Vegas is on 3-game winning streak (momentum). Golden State travel fatigue (cross-country on back-to-back road trip). Late-season June = playoff push mentality (Plum attack mode).
Risk: Golden State may employ zone defense to suppress Plum's scoring — requires adjustment. Foul trouble for Plum in first half could limit attempts.
